function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points (2024)** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • General speed limit on interstate highways: 70 mph (except in construction zones).
• Rural state highways: 65 mph.
• Urban roads: 55 mph unless posted otherwise.
• School zones: 25 mph during school hours. | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Failure to buckle up can result in a $50 fine. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is prohibited. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• For commercial drivers, the limit is 0.04%.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks.
• Stop signs and traffic signals must be obeyed. | | **Headlights & Visibility** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights are allowed only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and insurance. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked.
• Disabled parking spaces require a valid disabled placard. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Texas uses speed cameras in certain counties; fines are automatically issued. | | **School Bus Laws** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Failure to stop can result in a $500 fine. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Drivers must signal before changing lanes.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the left lane is occupied. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage.
• No‑fault insurance is required. | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles must wear helmets.
• Commercial vehicles must follow specific weight and size limits. | ### How to Find More Detailed Information 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online through the Texas Legislature’s website. 3. **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances or recent changes. Feel free to ask if you need details on a particular law or how to comply with a specific regulation!
